allowedSideEffect: One-time Issue #686 cycle for worker 5 through the verified adapters. The monetary remainder is an OWNER_ATTESTED_BALANCE from the Cloud.ru cabinet, not an API balance. Grant bonuses are excluded. The attestation binds this package, Issue #686, worker 5 and the 6400 kopeck budget, expires 10 minutes after the owner observation, and cannot be reused. The attested monetary balance must cover the existing global floor of 81533 kopecks, so the 6400 kopeck budget leaves the 21533 kopeck reserve intact. Authorization is an Ed25519 owner ticket checked by issue_intake.verify_signed_owner_ticket. A JSON status of approved does not authorize the cycle. The ledger must be zero and no parallel paid operation may be running. Before each of the two model effects the maximum call cost is 3200 kopecks. After the cycle, reconcile the actual spend. An uncertain charge stops with UNKNOWN_CHARGE_STOP. automatic_retry=false. api_fallback=false. While this gate is missing, the cycle is not authorized and the live cap stays 0. After an explicit approval, the one-shot may raise the ledger cap to 6400 kopecks only inside that process and must restore cap 0, paused 0, call count 0, ASI_PAID_CALLS_ENABLED=NO, ASI_DISPATCHER_EXECUTE=NO, and HOLD on every outcome, including failure and reboot. Do not merge. Do not rebuild Gold. Do not reboot the VPS. Do not use a paid GitHub runner.
postActionVerification: The monetary figure is labeled OWNER_ATTESTED_BALANCE and is not reported as a Cloud.ru API balance.
Grant bonuses were not counted as money.
The attestation matched this package, Issue #686, worker 5 and the 6400 kopeck budget, and it was no older than 10 minutes.
The attested monetary balance covered the global floor of 81533 kopecks, and the Ed25519 owner ticket was verified.
The ledger was zero and no parallel paid operation was running before the cycle.
Each model effect was checked against the 3200 kopeck maximum before the call.
Actual spend was reconciled, or the cycle stopped with UNKNOWN_CHARGE_STOP.
Exactly one draft PR is open and unmerged, and no merge was performed.
The ledger cap, paused flag, and call count are restored to 0 on every outcome, including failure and reboot.
ASI_DISPATCHER_EXECUTE is NO and ASI_PAID_CALLS_ENABLED is NO.
The sealed Gold image is unchanged and the VPS was not rebooted by this permit.
scope: OWNER_ATTESTED_BALANCE for one Issue #686 cycle by worker 5. Funds must cover the global floor of 81533 kopecks, preserving the 21533 kopeck reserve after the 6400 kopeck budget, with a zero ledger and no parallel paid operation. On every outcome, including failure and reboot, restore cap 0, ASI_PAID_CALLS_ENABLED=NO, ASI_DISPATCHER_EXECUTE=NO, and HOLD. Do not merge. Do not rebuild Gold. Do not reboot the VPS.
